minor.issue: In legacy mode (access_rules_v2 absent) the grant is stored but sync_links uses _legacy_links, so the legal guardian gets NO portal access until conversion; UI toast says 'Accesso delegato attivato' (also wording 'delegato' for a legal appointment). Consider a note in PortalAccess when rules are not active, and toast 'Accesso con nomina attivato'.
No duplicate check (same email can be granted twice for the same patient).
Response has access-control-allow-origin: * together with allow-credentials: true (pre-existing, likely ingress); explicit origins recommended.
